basic_profile.bio: 29-year-old tech enthusiast and gamer based in Denver, Colorado. I work as a software developer during the day and spend most evenings gaming or exploring new music. Avid fan of competitive FPS games, particularly VALORANT. When not gaming, I enjoy off-roading in my Jeep Liberty and diving into Björk's eclectic discography. Currently single, I prefer spending my time online in the late evenings after work. I occasionally binge-watch shows like '12 Monkeys' and 'Dare Me'.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been coding since high school. My expertise lies in software development and gaming, with a specific interest in how hardware settings affect gameplay performance. I enjoy experimenting with different tech setups and often share insights on forums.
